facts: Speaker DOA estimation accuracy is a key factor for mobile speech application.
Interference robustness is a key factor for mobile speech application.
Compact physical size is a key factor for mobile speech application.
An acoustic vector sensor (AVS) was utilized considering the size.
A DOA estimation algorithm was previously proposed.
The previously proposed DOA estimation algorithm offers high accuracy with larger-than-15dB SNR.
The previously proposed DOA estimation algorithm is deteriorated by non-speech interferences (NSI).
The paper develops a robust speaker DOA estimation algorithm.
The robust speaker DOA estimation algorithm is achieved by deriving the inter-sensor data ratio model of an AVS in bispectrum domain (BISDR).
The robust speaker DOA estimation algorithm is achieved by exploring the favorable properties of bispectrum.
The favorable properties of bispectrum include the zero value of Gaussian process.
The favorable properties of bispectrum include the different distribution of speech and NSI.
A reliable bispectrum mask is generated.
The generated bispectrum mask guarantees that the speaker DOA cues, derived from BISDR, are robust to NSI.
Intensive experiments demonstrate an improved performance of the proposed algorithm under various NSI conditions even when SIR is smaller than 0dB.
